item.title: This is the Iskra research and production plant in Uljanowsk, russia. Well .. was.
item.description: Ukraine just destroyed it with a handful of drones. Fun fact, this is the very place which manufactures, among other things, russian air defence components. - quote The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine confirmed a series of overnight deep strikes targeting three major Russian defense industrial plants across the Ulyanovsk, Tula, and Voronezh regions. The operation hit the Zavod Iskra facility in Ulyanovsk, a subsidiary of the Almaz-Antey defense conglomerate that manufactures specialized semiconductors and microelectronics for Pantsir-S1 air defense combat vehicles and Kh-59 air-to-surface guided missiles. Simultaneously, long-range attack drones struck the Efremov Synthetic Rubber Plant in Tula and the Voronezhsintezkauchuk facility in Voronezh, both of which produce critical chemical precursors and synthetic rubber components used in solid rocket fuel for Iskander ballistic missile systems. Geopolitically, expanding deep strikes into interior Russian manufacturing hubs reinforces Ukraine's strategy of degrading adversary war-fighting potential at the source. By hitting specialized chemical and electronics supply nodes up to 800 kilometers from the border, Kyiv demonstrates that key industrial installations remain within strike range. Disrupting domestic missile production lines reduces Russia's long-term capacity to sustain continuous long-range bombardments against Ukrainian cities, signaling to international partners that asymmetric air operations can effectively impair adversary military-industrial capacity despite global sanctions evasion networks. From a defense procurement perspective, targeting upstream component suppliers exposes single-point vulnerabilities within Russia's defense industrial base. Complex military hardware like Pantsir-S1 point-defense systems and Iskander-M ballistic missiles rely on tightly integrated supply networks. Destroying niche microelectronics production at Zavod Iskra and specialized rubber processing at chemical plants creates immediate bottlenecks, stalling final assembly lines at prime contractor facilities. Forcing Russian defense managers to rebuild chemical synthesis lines and import alternative semiconductors slows replacement rates for high-value air defense units and tactical ballistic missiles. Operationally, severing missile and air defense production pipelines directly weakens frontline Russian air defense and deep-strike capabilities over time. Pantsir-S1 units are essential for protecting frontline troops, command posts, and rear infrastructure from incoming Ukrainian drones and guided rockets. Degrading the production of replacement Pantsir units and solid-fuel Iskander rockets thin out Russian air defense coverage across active operational sectors, opening wider flight corridors for follow-on Ukrainian long-range uncrewed aerial attacks. Targeting Russian chemical and microelectronics plants allows Ukraine to disrupt the production chains behind Pantsir air defense systems and Iskander ballistic missiles. - unquote https://militarnyi.com/en/news/drones-attack-iskra-plant-involved-in-kh-59-missile-production/ https://english.nv.ua/russian-war/drone-attack-strikes-russian-electronics-factory-in-ulyanovsk-video-50644465.html

item.title: Slightly more intense side effects MY ASS!
item.description: #memes #socially_awesome_awkward_penguin I have gotten Covid and flu shots before. The Covid shots were always Pfizer. This was my first Moderna. Got it yesterday and felt fine. This morning I felt fine just a sore arm so I went on a bicycle training session. Part way on bike ride my arm went numb for a brief moment and I got more exhausted as the day dragged on to the point I felt like a zombie from the original Night of the Living Dead. I got cold-like symptoms but no fever thank goodness! I did my best to be two parents while mama spice was feeling worse than me. She gained energy over time while I’m the opposite. Baby Spice saw I fell asleep around 6 pm while watching Super Kitties with me and Mama Spice and put his blanket on me from his bedroom and got me a “pillow”…a couch cushion. Well, baby spice went to bed, I took a Tylenol PM and fall asleep before 7 pm…See you space cowboy… FP edit: I’m alive. I slept, according to my garmin watch, 9 hours and 40 minutes. I feel back to normal. The Tylenol PM helped.
